purpose: Create a reproducible audit chain connecting each property answer component to the evidence, legal source, reasoning scope, verification state and published snapshot version that produced it.
link_rules: Every material observed fact must link to its source record.
Every material legal proposition must link to its authoritative legal source.
Every property-specific fact must link to a verified property match.
Every historical fact must link to a date scope and date-match assessment.
Every published answer component must link to the fact or legal proposition from which it was assembled.
Every revised snapshot must retain its predecessor reference.
A source retrieval event is not itself proof of the proposition claimed from that source.

versioning.principle: Published snapshots are immutable records of the answer state at verification time.
versioning.revision_rule: A changed answer creates a new snapshot/version and records the reason for change.
versioning.predecessor_rule: The new snapshot must retain a link to the immediately preceding snapshot when one exists.

guardrails: Never create an audit entry that claims evidence was reviewed when it was not.
Never use the audit trail to manufacture missing evidence.
Never delete the provenance of a superseded snapshot.
Never treat a citation alone as proof that the cited source establishes the proposition.
If provenance is incomplete, expose the gap in the answer state.
